### AppStorageInstallationAdmission

```ts

>;
```

Trusted installation lifecycle admission, with no member identity or private

SQLite tables, indexes and initial revision state used by the App storage owner.

### createAppStorage()

```ts
function createAppStorage(options): object;
```

One SQLite owner for scoped App values; its views bind the admitted member.

#### Parameters

| Parameter        | Type                                                                                                                                                                             | Description                                                                 |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`        | \{ `sql`: `Readonly`\<\{ `exec`: (`statement`, ...`bindings`) => `WatchdogSqliteCursor`; \}\>; `now?`: () => `number`; `commit`: \<`A`\>(`body`) => `Effect`\<`A`, `Error`\>; \} | -                                                                           |
| `options.sql`    | `Readonly`\<\{ `exec`: (`statement`, ...`bindings`) => `WatchdogSqliteCursor`; \}\>                                                                                              | The SQLite connection shared with installation and membership changes.      |
| `options.now?`   | () => `number`                                                                                                                                                                   | Millisecond clock used for the existing per-principal write-rate limit.     |
| `options.commit` | \<`A`\>(`body`) => `Effect`\<`A`, `Error`\>                                                                                                                                      | Commit the supplied mutation atomically before publishing its invalidation. |

#### Returns

| Name                  | Type                                     | Description                                                                                      |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `purgeInstallation()` | (`address`) => `void`                    | Remove an installation's values and write counters inside its delete transaction.                |
| `purgeMember()`       | (`memberId`, `throughVersion`) => `void` | Remove a member's private values and counters through the revoked membership version.            |
| `openInstallation()`  | (`authorize`) => `object`                | Bind a lifecycle view to fresh installation admission; only declared team layers are accessible. |
| `open()`              | (`authorize`) => `object`                | Bind a member view to live admission, declared keys and the current membership version.          |
